sources.title: Geologic Enhanced Mapping System (GEMS) Prize Official Rules — September 2026

sources.title: USGS — GeoDAWN airborne magnetic and radiometric surveys data release
sources.supports: Official description of the GeoDAWN magnetic/radiometric survey and DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ. This does not establish matching LiDAR/DEM coverage.
sources.status: GEODAWN PROVENANCE ONLY — NOT LiDAR OR SGMC EVIDENCE
sources.how: This source describes the GeoDAWN geophysical survey only. It is not cited as evidence for the SGMC-derived exploratory proxy or native-resolution LiDAR coverage.

sources.title: Sare and Hilley (2018) — Scarplet: A Python package for topographic template matching and diffusion dating
sources.supports: Method precedent and publication metadata for template-matched scarp amplitude, morphologic age, orientation, and signal-to-noise outputs.
sources.how: Journal of Open Source Software, volume 3, issue 31, article 1066; Robert Sare and George E. Hilley; DOI verified against the JOSS journal record.

sources.title: Steger (1998) — An Unbiased Detector of Curvilinear Structures
sources.supports: Sub-pixel curvilinear-line detection and width estimation as a methodological precedent; not a geologic validation result.
sources.how: Carsten Steger, IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, volume 20, issue 2, pages 113–125; DOI verified against the ACM/IEEE record.

sources.title: Frangi, Niessen, Vincken, and Viergever (1998) — Multiscale vessel enhancement filtering
sources.supports: Hessian-eigenvalue multiscale line/vesselness method precedent; transfer to geomorphic scarps requires validation.
sources.how: MICCAI 1998, Lecture Notes in Computer Science volume 1496, pages 130–137; authors and DOI checked on the Springer record.

sources.title: AGU 2015 Fall Meeting Author Index — Sare, abstract T31A-2838
sources.supports: The author index associates Sare with abstract T31A-2838, ‘Mapping of normal fault scarps in airborne laser swath mapping data using wavelet analysis.’ It is prior-method context, not this project's result.
sources.status: PARTIAL — ID/title visible in the author index; individual abstract endpoint was not available
sources.how: Do not attribute algorithm details or quantitative performance to the abstract without its full record.
